market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are an established Premier League club with strong financial resources and a squad quality well above the relegation zone. Even with a poor 2024-25 finish, the true probability of relegation after 2025-26 is drastically lower than 34.5%, as historical relegation odds for clubs of similar stature rarely exceed 10%. The market appears to overreact to short-term form, creating a large edge for the No side.
evidence_points: West Ham have spent 13 consecutive seasons in the PL and last relegated in 2010-11.
Preseason relegation odds for such clubs are typically 5-10% implied probability.
Squad market value (~€400m) and wage bill are significantly higher than relegation candidates.
